summary: Ground every explicit full date in its own answer citations without interpreting ambiguous slash order.
decision_refs: The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
TrunkText publicly emphasizes answers sourced to project documents and exact source locations
An offline reproduction proved that component-wise numeric grounding accepted 2024-01-10 when the citation stated only 2024-01-05 and 2024-02-10
approval_evidence: The project-question request authorizes this deterministic answer-accuracy improvement.
known_limitations: The guard covers explicit full dates, not incomplete month/year or relative-date phrases.
ISO and English month-name formats are equivalent, but slash dates retain written order and never cross-convert because locale is ambiguous.
The guard does not validate calendar legality, calculate deadlines, infer chronology or choose a controlling source.
The guard does not prove that every relevant project document was uploaded or parsed.
